segmentation_helper.role: used only to derive relative word-count weights for a/b/c micro-segmentation; Spanish text is not imported into the Greek edition

greek_source.role: Greek source corpus; build reads repository-normalized SBLGNT tokens and verses

generation_policy.parallel_references: preserve every component as a witness; first reference component is primary for editorial unit text
generation_policy.microsegments: split Greek token sequence proportionally to editorial fragment weights, adjusting boundaries toward Greek punctuation
generation_policy.transparency: heuristic microsegments are explicitly marked; full verses and ranges are exact materializations from source corpus
